findings.title: POST 'Order of operations' select omits rotation and created_at required by the placement check
findings.location: POST handler 'Order of operations' vs 'Note placement algorithm → Server input set'
findings.problem: Order-of-operations lists the projection as 'pos_x pos_y pos_x_v pos_y_v photo_url z_index', but check (b) needs rotation (for rotatedAABB) and created_at (middle key of the (z_index, created_at, _id) comparator). Following the Order-of-operations list literally corrupts the 60% invariant.
findings.fix: Make both lists identical: select 'pos_x pos_y pos_x_v pos_y_v photo_url z_index rotation created_at' (_id returned by default). State once that this single projection feeds both placement passes.

findings.title: isPhoto needed for every existing note's height but derivation is unspecified
findings.location: Note placement algorithm → Server input set; noteBox(isPhoto) helper
findings.problem: Each existing note's inflated box uses PHOTO_NOTE_H iff it is a photo note, but the design never states how isPhoto is derived for existing notes, and whether a text+photo note counts. Mis-derivation breaks the 35%/60% math for mixed notes.
findings.fix: State once: isPhoto = Boolean(photo_url) is the only height-determining flag, derived identically at placement and render time; .mz-note--photo taller box applies under the exact same photo_url != null condition.

findings.title: Vertical pass seed height and growth step under-specified; 'one screen-dimension' is undefined server-side
findings.problem: Vertical pass fixes width to 420 but never pins initial wall.height or the growth increment; 'grow by one screen-dimension' has no meaning on the server. Placement is order/state-dependent, so unspecified seed/growth breaks the determinism the revision relies on.
findings.fix: Pin server-side constants in lib/notePlacement.ts: V_WALL_SEED_HEIGHT, a fixed GROWTH_STEP in logical px (not 'one screen'), monotonic non-shrinking growth, so re-placement of the same set is stable.

findings.title: Horizontal canvas height is a client value (viewport height) but 2D placement needs a fixed logical height
findings.location: Layout → Desktop; Note placement algorithm (wall.height, horizontal pass)
findings.problem: Desktop canvas height = '100vh', a per-device client value, yet server placement is 2D (pos_y matters) and the 35%/60% invariant is computed against the server's wall.height. If server height != rendered height, notes overflow/compress and the invariant diverges from what the viewer sees. The vertical pass fixed its width for this exact reason.
findings.fix: Define a fixed logical H_WALL_HEIGHT (e.g. 900) in lib/notePlacement.ts, use it for the horizontal pass, and render the desktop canvas scaled from that logical height (mirroring the mobile scale-the-canvas decision) instead of raw 100vh.

findings.title: coveredFraction call contract (recentred inflated origin) and the 40-cell boundary are not pinned
findings.location: coveredFraction definition + step 4b invocation + invariants section
findings.problem: coveredFraction samples from pos_x/pos_y as top-left, but inflated boxes are recentred (pos_x' = cx - w'/2); the call site never says to pass the recentred inflated origin, so an implementer may sample an offset box. Also the exactly-40-cells (=60% visible) boundary is left to re-interpretation.
findings.fix: Specify callers pass the recentred inflated box { pos_x: cx - w'/2, pos_y: cy - h'/2, w: w', h: h' } for A and every higher-z box; state once: reject iff strictly more than 40 of 100 cells are covered (exactly 40 / >=60% visible passes).

findings.title: Clarify PromiseNote model is only ever created via getPromiseNoteModel()
findings.problem: Nothing forbids accidentally binding the model to the default (main) connection via mongoose.model(...).
findings.fix: Add a one-line note that the model must only be created through getPromiseNoteModel() on the separate connection; no logic change.

findings.title: Redundant findById before findOneAndUpdate in report route
findings.problem: findById is a second round-trip whose only job is the 404; findOneAndUpdate already returns null when no doc matches.
findings.fix: Drop findById; use 'if (!updated) return 404' on the findOneAndUpdate result and keep the auto-hide check on that same doc.

findings.title: State that only Cloudinary *Url (never blob:/data: previews) are submitted
findings.location: Composer submit flow + POST validation table
findings.problem: draft holds blob:/data: previews (drawingDataUrl/photoDataUrl) and Cloudinary URLs; the Cloudinary-only regex would 400 a preview URL if accidentally submitted.
findings.fix: One sentence: submit sends only draft.drawingUrl/draft.photoUrl (Cloudinary); the *DataUrl previews are never sent.
